docs.title: AI Architecture & Technical Reference
docs.text:
George Tudorica · Updated 25 August 2025

A working knowledge base connecting business requirements with AI solution design, architecture, Azure technologies and practical implementation.

  • AI Use Cases

    Business context, intended outcomes, requirements, solution concepts and AI workflows.

  • Solution Architecture

    Target architectures, component responsibilities, integrations, data flows and the reasoning behind design decisions.

  • Azure Technologies

    Service capabilities, technology selection, implementation patterns and the role each service plays within a solution.

  • Technical References

    Reusable technical notes, commands, configuration guidance, engineering decisions and implementation details.

docs.title: Workspace purpose
docs.text:
This workspace brings related knowledge together in a living technical reference, keeping the reasoning behind a solution alongside its architecture and implementation details.

Content can evolve through Markdown, diagrams and version control, with a consistent structure for publishing it as HTML documentation.

docs.title: Current focus
docs.text:
Building reusable AI solution patterns that connect business requirements, required capabilities, architecture, technology choices and implementation.

The guiding principle is to start with the business need and define what the solution must do before selecting technologies.
